scope: Explicitly selected final-source provider attempts: 4; complete genuine runs receiving replies: 4; diagnostic-only zero-reply attempts: 0; reported terminations: {'success': 3, 'failure': 1}. Scripted and synthetic checks are separate from model capability evidence.
provenance_scope: Contract v3 binds current harness/sandbox source plus expected Dockerfiles, Compose, .dockerignore and dependency build inputs, normalized across LF/CRLF and baked into the harness. It is not attestation of the active Docker daemon, effective mounts or network configuration.
historical_evidence: Prior source versions, including earlier eight-task runs and provider outcomes, remain historical. No older success or test result has been relabeled as current nine-task evidence.
clock_limit: Elapsed values are recorded by the harness/test monotonic clocks. Host/VM pauses have caused large UTC timestamp gaps; these measurements are not independent external wall-clock certification.
administrative_status: Repository and ZIP use exact team name ASTRO. Public visibility remains user requested and conflicts with the PS private-repository rule. The user will submit the official form personally; form submission and team eligibility are not attested.

limitations: Synthetic conformance is not unknown-model ability or a live judge run.
Source/build hashes describe expected inputs, not an active Docker daemon attestation.
The fixture environment checks protocol transitions and does not exercise satellite physics.
